text: Elara tightened her grip on the polished brass railing of the mag-lev transport as it hummed through the vacuum tube, speeding toward the Neo-Pacific colonies. It was 2184, and she was leaving behind the suffocating regulations of her heritage sector in Old London for the promise of autonomy and discovery in the Martian Outposts. She clutched her small, battered data-slate that contained all her digital identity and personal archives, her heart racing with both fear and excitement. Tell me what a book is primarily made of.
